Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Belar Quoren: 29-year-old man, 172 cm (medium), soft rounded construction with an evident middle and gentle limb contours, skin value band-5-medium-deep. Face: wide triangular face; large hooded eyes and a broken brow line; prominent bridge, compact mouth; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: red-copper-auburn, curls-coils-halo, deliberate accent: high gathered coil mass. Wardrobe: draped-robe, specifically a draped robe whose belting and openings keep the body construction legible; a high soft collar and uneven layered hems; bounded palette lilac-smoke. Visible personal details: no accessory and no tattoo. Make repair, patina, customization, or a keepsake the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: ornate hair maintenance with plain clothing care. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a folded handkerchief only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
